imported_interface: The entry declaration owns a resolved imported type reference. The opt-in hydrates Payload and authored import/definition support. Its canonical edge remains file-owned, so this source-delivery gain is not a new function-to-Payload semantic edge.
local_interface: The parameter and interface are local declarations. The entry probe has no supported imported-type reference, so this policy adds no definition. Any call-count difference includes agent workflow variation and the changed response metadata.
local_alias_chain: The alias chain is entirely local. No imported-type expansion is available from the entry or the required local declarations; the agent still has to retrieve those definitions explicitly.
imported_alias_chain: The entry can hydrate imported Second. The next steps from Second through First to Payload are local aliases and are outside existing imported-reference coverage. Two B repetitions already requested all four declarations together; only one repetition received Second as added context.
named_type_reexport_chain: The supported imported reference reaches the original Payload definition through authored re-export support. Two B repetitions issued the relevant entry get and received added context; repetition two made no get call, so the opt-in could not affect that retrieval path.
same_name_wrong_file: The resolved import selects types.ts::Payload rather than the same-named local distractor. Every B repetition received the correct added definition.
local_heritage: The local class and interface heritage relationships are not imported-type references. The entry probe adds no context; explicit local extends/implements coverage remains absent from this policy.
imported_heritage: The class owns an imported type-only Contract reference, which the probe can hydrate, but Base comes from an ordinary value import and is outside this policy. Actual B requests already included Contract with the class, so the response adds relationship/support records without repeating its body. These are generic references_type edges, not new extends or implements semantics.
ambiguous_star_exports: The applicable imported-type reference is unresolved. The policy reports unresolved_reference and returns no guessed target definition. This is an intentional negative outcome.
generic_shadow: The generic Payload parameter shadows the imported name. Diagnostic records for the annotation uses remain unresolved, and the policy adds no imported target. The earlier shorthand that all such references disappear was too broad: the repaired guarantee is that they do not become proven imported-type edges.
exported_arrow: The task follows a value/call relationship to an exported arrow. The repaired endpoint remains available, but neither the entry nor its number annotation supplies an imported type-only expansion.
default_identifier: The task follows a value/call relationship through an identifier default export. Existing endpoint and call resolution remain intact; this type-only policy adds no definition.
named_function_control: The control follows a value/call relationship to a named function with primitive types. No imported type-only expansion is available or expected.
inline_default_control: The control follows a value/call relationship to an inline default function with primitive types. No imported type-only expansion is available or expected.
anvil_temporal_arguments: temporalCliArgs, TemporalQuery, TemporalView, TEMPORAL_VIEWS and TemporalTransition are local to temporal.ts. None of the required endpoint probes has an applicable type-only import reference. The missing path is local parameter/property/alias/type-query coverage, not a demonstrated ownership or budget exclusion.
anvil_retrieval_limits: The entry can hydrate imported BrainRetrievalResult and then imported TemporalQuery. Required omission, stop, reporting and diagnostic types are local declarations in retrieve.ts and have no applicable imported-type expansion. The unavailable-evidence helper is a call relationship, outside this type-only traversal. TemporalQuery is returned through a real existing reference but is not required gold context for this task.
anvil_renderer_result_contract: The entry can hydrate imported BrainRetrievalResult and then TemporalQuery. Required BrainProjectResolution, PromptBrainContextRender and BrainContextRender depend on local property, return and intersection relationships outside existing imported-type coverage. TemporalQuery is a proven imported dependency but is not required gold context for this task.
